name: replace-name
description: Wholly invented parcel quotes: up to and including 500 grams costs 4 units; heavier parcels cost 7 units; priority adds 3 units. The local adapter deliberately mishandles exactly 500 grams.

selection.method: Eight independently invented boundary and ordinary cases
limitations: Synthetic local demonstration only; no network or model inference.
These examples do not describe any customer or production distribution.

criteria.description: Return an object with a nonnegative integer price.
Return the price specified by the independently defined inclusive weight rule and priority surcharge.
